messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident opened: Policy engine runtime panic causing smart-routing fallback loop. Paging oncall.

oncall-rotation: paging sam (primary oncall) — please acknowledge. severity: P1. impact: some requests routed to wrong model variant + cross-region fallbacks creating elevated latencies.

sam: acked. i'm on it. quick ask — any customer-facing errors yet?

incident-bot: Alerts: increased 5xx proxy errors, model-misroute alerts, and routing-thrashing metric spike. Top affected region: eu-west-1 -> fallback to us-east-1 churn.

maria: seeing KCACHE logs showing repeated policy eval failures with `panic: runtime error: slice bounds out of range`. sample log:

```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z policy-eval service[pid=1224]: panic: runtime error: slice bounds out of range
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z policy-eval service[pid=1224]: goroutine 45 [running]:
runtime/panic.go:88 +0x...
internal/policy/eval.go:317 +0x9f2
```

alex: hmm looks like an indexing bug when expression contains optional attribute access + regex. new rule that rolled out earlier today uses `request.context.user_agents[0]` without guard.

sam: ok mitigation plan: 1) pause policy rollout, 2) set routing fallback to hard default model variant (no dynamic variants), 3) scale up healthy replicas, 4) notify CS. I'll run commands.

sam: running:
```
# pause rollout
curl -XPOST "https://controlplane/api/v1/policies/rollouts/pause" -d '{"policy_id":"smart-routing-v3"}'
# set default route
curl -XPOST "https://controlplane/api/v1/routing/override" -d '{"mode":"force_default","model":"gpt-redwood-1"}'
```

dev-reliability: i've applied the override to force default model. routing churn metric dropped ~60% in the last 30s. still seeing some 5xx traces from region failovers (in-flight requests).

maria: i've identified the policy expression that triggers panic. reproducer attached (local run):

```
expr := `if regexp_match(request.headers["x-client"], "^svc-") { return request.context.user_agents[0] == "bot" }
`
```

alex: thanks. adding guard `len(request.context.user_agents) > 0 && ...` should fix. creating hotfix PR.

sam: customer-impact check: CS — which customers hit errors?

customer-success: initial sweep: 3 mid-market tenants showed elevated request errors and latency spikes (approx 1-3% of their requests) from 14:01-14:10 UTC. We opened tickets and created outage notes. No data loss; degraded responses and increased tail latency.

sam: good. continue mitigation: rolling restart of policy-eval pods to clear panicked instances.

dev-reliability: doing rolling restart now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/policy-eval -n redwood`. patch will be merged to trunk after PR review.

maria: PR merged with guard; infra tests pass. scheduling canary to ensure no new panics.

incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled in 40 minutes. current status: mitigation applied (override routing), rolling restarts in progress, patch merged. monitoring: error rate trending down.

sam: assigning follow-ups: (1) postmortem writeup, (2) add unit tests for optional-field access in policy runtime, (3) improve policy runtime to sandbox and fail closed without panic — create tickets.

customer-success: we've updated the three affected customers and will follow up with RCA and timeline. CC: account teams.

sam: thanks everyone. i'll leave runbook notes and the temporary override id `ovr-20260315-01` in the incident doc. moving to monitoring/mitigated — oncall will follow up on postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to mitigated. End time: 2026-03-15T14:17:22Z. Postmortem owner: sam.
